title: dcm2niix
description: Chris Rorden's dcm2niiX - DICOM to NIfTI converter. Converts DICOM files to NIfTI format with optional BIDS sidecar generation.

adjacent.description: Adjacent DICOMs (images from same series always in same folder) for faster conversion
adjacent.title: Adjacent DICOMs

bids.description: Generate BIDS sidecar JSON files (o=only: no NIfTI)
bids.title: BIDS sidecar

bids_anon.description: Anonymize BIDS sidecar files by removing personal information
bids_anon.title: Anonymize BIDS

comment.description: Comment stored in NIfTI aux_file (up to 24 characters)
comment.title: Comment

depth.description: Directory search depth for DICOM files in sub-folders
depth.title: Search depth

export_format.description: Export format: NRRD (y), MGH (o), JSON/JNIfTI (j), or BJNIfTI (b)
export_format.title: Export format

filename.description: Output filename template (%a=antenna, %b=basename, %c=comments, %d=description, %e=echo number, %f=folder name, %g=accession number, %i=ID of patient, %j=seriesInstanceUID, %k=studyInstanceUID, %m=manufacturer, %n=name of patient, %o=mediaObjectInstanceUID, %p=protocol, %r=instance number, %s=series number, %t=time, %u=acquisition number, %v=vendor, %x=study ID; %z=sequence name)
filename.title: Filename template

defaults.description: Generate defaults file (o=only: reset and write defaults; i=ignore: reset defaults)
defaults.title: Generate defaults

scaling.description: Losslessly scale 16-bit integers (y=scale, n=no but uint16->int16, o=original)
scaling.title: Integer scaling

merge_2d.description: Merge 2D slices from same series regardless of echo, exposure, etc. (0=no, 1=yes, 2=auto)
merge_2d.title: Merge 2D slices

series_number.description: Only convert specified series CRC number (can be used up to 16 times)
series_number.title: Series number

output_dir.description: Output directory (omit to save to input folder)
output_dir.title: Output directory

philips_scaling.description: Use Philips precise float (not display) scaling
philips_scaling.title: Philips scaling

search_mode.description: Search mode (y=show number of DICOMs, l=list DICOMs, n=no)
search_mode.title: Search mode

single_file.description: Single file mode, do not convert other images in folder
single_file.title: Single file mode

conflict_behavior.description: Write behavior for name conflicts (0=skip, 1=overwrite, 2=add suffix)
conflict_behavior.title: Conflict behavior

crop_3d.description: Crop 3D acquisitions (i=ignore: neither crop nor rotate)
crop_3d.title: Crop 3D

compression.description: gz compress images (y=pigz, o=optimal pigz, i=internal:zlib, n=no, 3=no,3D)
compression.title: Compression

input_dir.description: Input folder containing DICOM files. Will be searched recursively based on depth parameter.
input_dir.title: Input directory
